name: TOB WhatsApp Message
description: One row per WhatsApp message (inbound, mirrored from a Chatwoot webhook; outbound, recorded when the admin/a campaign sends one) mirrored under a TOB WhatsApp Conversation. Sends/receives text and media (image/document/audio/video) both ways — attachment_url points at Chatwoot's own hosted copy of the file (this backend never proxies or stores the media itself, only the URL Chatwoot returns/reports). Never stores a Chatwoot credential, only correlation IDs.

fields.label: Chatwoot Message ID
fields.description: Used for idempotency when mirroring an inbound Chatwoot webhook delivery, which is not guaranteed exactly-once.

fields.label: Message Type
fields.options:
TEXT
IMAGE
DOCUMENT
AUDIO
VIDEO
UNSUPPORTED

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Text content; for a non-text message_type, a caption if any. The media itself is not proxied or stored by this backend.

fields.label: Attachment URL
fields.description: Chatwoot's own hosted URL for this message's attachment (its `data_url`), set for a non-TEXT message_type both directions. Points at Chatwoot, not this site — never uploaded/proxied here.
